growth.note: Share of the adult value reached at each age (effective age = age minus maturity offset). Height and the under-18 columns are the D8.1.1 table. Weight from 18 follows T8.1.1 and D8.1.1's own acceptance band (4 to 7 percent gain 18 to 22) instead of the table's 91 to 99 percent. Speed follows T8.1.1 (40-yard change 0 to 0.05 s over college) instead of the table's 93 percent at 16 and 97 at 18, so late maturers (effective age near 17 at enrolment) also stay inside the college band; 14 is raised to keep the curve smooth. strengthRel is the share relative to the age-18 strength share; from 18 the T8.1.1 per-group gains apply.

collegeYearShare.note: Share of the four-year strength gain earned in college years 1 to 4: about 60 percent in years 1 and 2, about 15 percent in year 4 (T8.1.1 rule 1). The split of the first 60 and of year 3 is an Assumption.

curves.note: Yearly percent change in the physical index by age (age on September 1), one band per year. Fitted by packages/league/test/development/tools/fit-aging.ts to the measured production change by age (facts/aging.json F-aging-0012..0022; targets in facts/aging-build/targets.json): a ramp -m x (age - start + 1) from the start age, chosen by least squares on the whole-player value from 25 to 34. primeEnd is the last age within value.primeBandIss of the fitted peak; declineIssPerYear the mean yearly loss over the four years after it. The targets carry survivor bias, so decline after 30 is if anything too mild.

agingWeights.note: Multiplier on the yearly physical change per output. Forty blends top speed (1.0) and acceleration (1.1); the ten split is acceleration; cone and shuttle are change of direction; jumps and the explosiveness attribute are explosiveness. Play strength 0.3 until 31, then 0.7 (also arm and leg strength). Recovery rate is exposed for D10.

exitRates.note: Percent of player-seasons (at least 4 games) that are the player's last. results/aging_exit_hazard.csv, nflverse seasons to 2023, cells with at least 30 player-seasons. Status 1 of 3 (PROVISIONAL). null = n/a in the leaf (fewer than 30 player-seasons); the nearest younger age is used.
